final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(1.0 * (ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0)) AS avg_shape_delta, SUM(ss.aream2) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0) AS area_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS ss JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) AS avg_group_ratio FROM step1) SELECT step1.fundflux, step1.avg_shape_delta, step1.area_volume_ratio, step1.area_volume_ratio - step2.avg_group_ratio AS ratio_difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.avg_group_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.area_volume_ratio > step2.avg_group_ratio
